text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: (The Solefall Faire.)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
('Tis the autumn variant of the annual Fan
Fests. Unlike the sporty
feeling of spring,
the autumn variant is distinct not only in
name.)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(Classes and teams alike gather
voluntarily to put out a variety of
exhibits. You could
say it is like Tracen's very own
celebration of culture.)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(In other words,
it's a veritable feast for
the eyes—a divinely bestowed assemblage
of Umamusume giving it their all in a
non-race setting!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(My name is Agnes Digital. I'm just your
average, ordinary
Umamusume.)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(I prefer to live behind a filter so as to
not
breathe the same air as my
precious Umas.
However...)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Step right up for the hauntiest of houses!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(How did I end up like this,
the gaudiest of
sights for all to see? Well,
it all started
about a month ago...)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(The hum of the cicadas remained loud
and clear as we stood at the
finis of our
summer vacation...)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(And the illustrious Legion of the Demon
Queen boasted only one
member.)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Hehehehehe. Heh! Heh! Heh! Heh!
Heh!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahahaha! My plans for the ultimate
haunted house—the superest of scares; the
pinnacle of panics! Windy's Demonic
Castle is ready for
the darkness of night!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Anyone who dares step foot inside will
succumb to the dreadliest of
dread!

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
I think you mean "most dreadful of dread."
Good morning, Windy!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Oh, g'morning to you too! I assume you
wish to join the legions of
Demon Queen
Windy?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
If you insist,
then I suppose I could accept
you within my ranks. Demon Queen
Windy's Castle is a humongous plan, after
all.

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Haha. I bet it is.
I can see you've put a lot
of thought into making all
kinds of pranks.
Try not to overdo it, okay?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Eh? Wait,
this isn't really s'posed to be a
prank or anything...

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Sorry! Can you show me your sports
nutrition textbook? I totally
blanked on
our quiz today!

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes.
I had a feeling this might happen.
See you later, Windy!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ah... Erm...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! This really isn't just a bunch of
pranks...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I just thought now would be a good time...
The Solefall Faire is perfect for getting
everyone together to make Windy's
Demonic
Castle a success...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Well, whatever! I'm plenty the demonic
mastermind all on my own! As
long as I've
got my planbook on me...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
As long as... I've got my planbook...
Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
It's gone! My precious planbook!
It's gone,
gone, GONE! I must've
dropped it
somewhere!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Urgh... Can't find it around here either.
It's
over... So, so, over!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
All those nights dwelling in the darkness
to come up with the perfect
plans...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Crash!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wh-what happened?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Doto! Are you okay?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Owie owie owie... I-I'm fine, but more
importantly, this notebook on
the ground
is safe...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
You would contort your body in such a
way to avoid trampling a lost object?
Might you be the patron saint of charity?
Nay, might thou be
an angel?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Well, considering I ended up
falling, I'd say I'm still just a
klutz...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
O Mother Nature! May your beautiful
bounties continue to nourish
and protect
this most blessed soul until the end of
time!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
U-um, anyway, what do we have here?
"Demonic Castle... Blueprints"?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ah! That's my notebook!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
(I need to get it back, stat! I can't have
more people think I'm
planning some
stupid pranks...)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Oho? Ohohoho? "Windy's Demonic
Castle"?! It rings quite
majestically in the
ear, does it not?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hmm?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Wow... This is really quite detailed. It's
incredible!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: (Hmmm?)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: A haunted house in the form of a castle? Now that's something I'd love to see and hear—to live from start to finish!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
This looks like quite an ambitious
exhibit.
It would be fun to see it
work out.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you two! I heard everything, and I
accept your praise!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'll have both of you join my legion as
generals! S-so now you've
gotta, um...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
You've gotta help me make Windy's
Demonic Castle a devilishly huge
success!
